intent.purpose: character concept Mei (31): hook or proof slide in the saved hallway propped-phone style, for a walking-changed-my-body slideshow
intent.scene_concept: after her early walk and before work, she films a talk-to-camera update from the short hall between the kitchen and bedroom; a different spot, outfit and moment from the source frame
intent.place_type: lived-in rental apartment interior (never a gym, studio, hotel or styled show flat)
must_stay_true: same photographic style as digest S1: a still pulled from a vertical phone video, plandid, soft off-camera window daylight, muted warm off-white palette, video-frame softness
the phone is propped low at about hip height and films her from about two metres away, tilted slightly upward, so the frame shows a big band of ceiling and cuts her off at the upper thigh
it is an apartment interior in daytime with nothing styled for the camera
she is mid-sentence talking to the camera with her hands caught mid-swing

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: at least as attractive as the woman in the style source; the digest carries only the photo's treatment, never her looks
appeal.face: elegant, very pretty face: almond-shaped dark eyes, soft straight brows, a small straight nose, a defined cupid's bow and a delicate jaw
appeal.physique: petite and sculpted: toned arms, a flat defined stomach, a small waist and toned legs

subject.description: one woman recording a quick morning update from her apartment hall
subject.action: talking to the camera, right hand swinging with an earbud case loosely in her fingers, left hand relaxed
subject.pose: standing square to the camera, feet together, slight lean forward as she makes a point
subject.gaze: straight into the lens of the propped phone
subject.face_visibility: full face visible and in focus, lit softly from the front-left

identity.skin: light warm ivory skin with a natural pink flush on the cheeks
identity.hair: glossy straight black hair in a sleek high ponytail with wispy curtain bangs
identity.face: oval face, almond-shaped dark eyes, soft straight brows, small straight nose, defined lips, no visible makeup

physique.proportions: short torso, small waist, toned legs, slender defined arms
physique.detail: a strip of midriff visible; a flat stomach with faint definition

wardrobe.fit_and_condition: leggings slightly bunched at the knees below frame, a faint sweat mark at the bra band, fabric a little bobbled at the hips

environment.setting: short hall between the kitchen and the bedroom of a one-bedroom apartment
foreground: the out-of-focus rim of a fruit bowl with a banana on the kitchen island intrudes at the bottom-left corner
background: a white bedroom door half open behind her, showing a slice of a made bed with a rumpled grey duvet
a white bifold linen closet door at right
a small hallway window at far left with white blinds half open
a laundry hamper against the wall at right, lid open
flat off-white walls and an unlit recessed light in the ceiling
environment.clutter: a folded work cardigan draped over the hamper, a tote bag leaning against the wall, a charging cable dangling from an outlet

camera.device: iPhone 13, rear main camera recording 1080p vertical video, propped upright against something on a counter
camera.position: propped against the fruit bowl on the kitchen island at about hip height, tilted up about 10 degrees
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the door, walls and background objects are as sharp as the video allows, with no background blur

composition.framing: top of her head to her upper thighs; legs cut off by the bottom edge
composition.subject_placement: centred horizontally, head at about 40 percent of the frame height, torso across the middle third
composition.crop: bottom edge cuts through her upper thighs; a hand is partly cut by the side edge as it swings
composition.tilt: upward keystone from the low camera: door frames and wall corners lean inward toward the top; about 1 degree of roll
composition.headroom: large: the top third of the frame is plain ceiling with an unlit recessed light, left empty for a caption added later in the editor

sources: soft early-morning daylight through the half-open blinds of the hall window at left
fainter daylight from the kitchen behind the phone
lighting.direction: from the left, falling off toward the right-hand wall and the ceiling
lighting.quality: soft, wrapping daylight with gentle shadows under the chest band and beside the waist; no hard cast shadows
lighting.exposure: exposed for her skin; the ceiling and far corner fall into warm grey shadow, the lit door stays just under clipping

color.white_balance: neutral-to-warm daylight; white walls and doors render as warm off-white and greige, never blue
color.saturation: muted overall; her skin is the warmest, most saturated area
color.contrast: low to medium, with no crushed blacks except the darkest fabric
casts: warm yellow-beige cast on the shadowed ceiling and walls
brownish falloff on the wall farthest from the window

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app video re-encoded by TikTok; the image looks like one frame grabbed from that clip
processing.hdr: flat, slightly washed phone-video HDR tone curve
processing.sharpening: light video sharpening; fine detail limited by the video codec
processing.noise_reduction: temporal noise reduction smearing fine texture in the shadows
processing.compression: HEVC re-encode: macroblocking and banding in the flat ceiling gradient, soft edges

imperfections: motion blur on her right hand and the earbud case
video-frame softness with blocky compression in the ceiling
slightly clipped highlight on the window blinds
upward keystone lean on the bedroom door frame
out-of-focus fruit bowl rim at the bottom edge

texture.skin: fine pores and a light morning flush; a faint sheen on the forehead from the walk
texture.hair: sleek ponytail with a few flyaways at the crown and bangs separating
texture.fabric: ribbed cream knit with light bobbling and creases
texture.surfaces: painted doors, flat drywall, white vinyl blinds

motion.subject: arms swinging loosely as she talks and shifts her weight; body otherwise near-still
motion.blur: motion blur on her hands and forearms only; face and torso sharp

anatomy: two arms and two hands; each hand has five fingers, and blurred hands keep a plausible hand shape
two legs, cut off at the upper thigh by the frame edge
shoulders, waist and hips in natural proportion for a camera below chest height
physics: the bedroom door hangs plumb and is half open on its hinges
the hamper lid rests open against the wall
geometry.reflections: no mirror in frame; no reflections beyond a soft sheen on door paint
geometry.perspective: low camera tilted up: verticals converge toward the top, the ceiling plane is visible, her legs look long and her head is slightly smaller

phone.hold: not held: the phone is propped on the counter out of frame and is the camera

typography.scene_text: no legible text; the earbud case has no readable writing

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding where a real apartment would show it, small and incidental; do not invent new readable words
brands: a white AirPods charging case in her hand, shape only
the banana's supermarket sticker, too small to read

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no mirror, no visible phone and no selfie arm
no ring light, softbox or golden-hour glow
no cinematic grade, film grain or vignette
no styled decor arranged for the camera
no text overlays, captions or watermarks
no invented or garbled text on products

may_copy: soft off-camera window daylight and its falloff
propped low camera height, upward tilt and distance
head-to-upper-thigh framing with the ceiling band
video-frame softness, compression and hand motion blur
must_preserve: talk-to-camera body check from a propped phone
must_not_transfer: the source person's face, body, skin, hair and jewellery
the source outfit (two-tone sports bra, dark leggings)
the exact hallway, closet door, switch plate and outlet layout
